steps.summary: Hug top-right water edge around curve → Defeat Guard Captain → Rescue Clarissa → Enter Sarn Encampment
steps.layout_tell: Follow the river curve from East to North-West; Clarissa is always fighting guards right before the Town staircase.
steps.next_exit: Talk to Clarissa → Enter The Sarn Encampment
steps.portal_tip: Always talk to Clarissa before entering Town so she gives Sewer Keys later!

actions.text: Follow the curved river path North-West
Kill Blackguards around Clarissa & talk to her!
Climb stairs into The Sarn Encampment

steps.boss_info: Guard Captain: Uses Glacial Hammer; easy kill.
steps.gem_reward: Clarissa unlocks the Sewer Keys after Crematorium.

variants.title: Curved River Path
variants.desc: Always curves from SE around the water to NW town stairs.

steps.summary: Act 3 Town Hub → Check Clarissa/Hargan → Exit North-East up the stairs into The Slums
steps.layout_tell: Clarissa is by the bottom steps; Waypoint is in the center; stairs to The Slums are at the top-right (NE).
steps.next_exit: Climb NE stairs → Enter The Slums
steps.portal_tip: Clarissa unlocks Level 24 Curses & Aura Gems after you rescue Tolman in The Crematorium!

actions.text: Tag Sarn Encampment Waypoint in center of town
Climb the North-East stairs into The Slums

steps.boss_info: Safe Town Hub (Clarissa, Maramoa, Hargan, Grigor).
steps.gem_reward: Clarissa sells Lvl 24 Curse/Aura gems (after Crematorium) and Lvl 28 Gems (after Gravicius).

variants.title: Fixed Town Hub
variants.desc: Enter at SW from City of Sarn; exit NE to The Slums.

steps.summary: Exit Sarn Encampment North → Climb metal stairs & head North/North-East to The Crematorium
steps.layout_tell: Ignore the locked Sewer Grating for now; climb metal stairs heading generally North to find The Crematorium.
steps.portal_tip: No Waypoint in The Slums — Crematorium WP is right inside its entrance!

actions.text: Run North/North-East up the metal staircases
Enter The Crematorium

steps.gem_reward: Leads to Crematorium (Lvl 24 Curse & Guard skill gems).

variants.title: Rooftop Stairs
variants.desc: Crematorium is always on the upper northern half of The Slums.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural city grid: Crematorium & Sewer Grating spawn in varying northern corners

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Complete Lab Trial #4 (Fire Furnaces) → Defeat Piety → Take Tolman's Bracelet → Logout
steps.layout_tell: Lab Trial #4 is usually along the first main outer wall; Piety & Tolman are at the far end past narrow dungeon bridges.
steps.next_exit: Loot Tolman's Bracelet → Logout to Town → Get Sewer Keys from Clarissa
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after looting Tolman's Bracelet → Talk to Clarissa (Sewer Keys) & Maramoa (Lvl 24 Gems)!

actions.text: Tag Waypoint right inside entrance
Complete Trial of Ascendancy (Normal Trial 4/6 — Fire Grates)
Damage Piety to 50% HP → Click Tolman for Bracelet → Relog to Town

steps.boss_info: Piety: Casts Lightning Storm & Ball Lightning (high Lightning damage!). Equip Topaz Rings!
steps.gem_reward: Lost in Love (Maramoa): Unlocks Lvl 24 Curse, Brand & Banner Gems (Flammability, Conductivity, Frostbite, Sniper's Mark, Determination, Grace, Pride, Hatred, Wrath, Zealotry, Anger)!

variants.title: Looping Dungeon
variants.desc: Hug left or right perimeter wall to hit Trial then Piety's arena.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural dungeon: Trial #4 & Piety's corridor vary by seed — hug outer walls

steps.summary: Enter Sewers from Slums → Collect 1st Bust → Tag WP → Collect 2nd & 3rd Busts → Exit to Marketplace
steps.layout_tell: 1st Platinum Bust is ALWAYS before the Waypoint; 2nd and 3rd Busts are ALWAYS after the Waypoint!
steps.next_exit: Collect all 3 Platinum Busts (+1 Skill Point) → Exit to The Marketplace
steps.portal_tip: Rule of thumb: 1 Bust before WP, 2 Busts after WP!

actions.text: Find 1st Platinum Bust in side stash before the Waypoint
Tag The Sewers Waypoint
Loot 2nd & 3rd Busts after WP → Climb ladder to The Marketplace

steps.boss_info: Chaos Spitters & Undying Grapplers (Discharge): Do not stand in large packs when they have Endurance/Power charges.
steps.gem_reward: Victario's Secrets (Hargan): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point + 2 Respec Points).

variants.title: Linear Waterway
variants.desc: 1st Bust is pre-WP; 2nd & 3rd Busts are post-WP near Marketplace exit.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural waterways: 1 Bust spawns before the WP and 2 Busts spawn after the WP

steps.summary: Run North-East through broken arches → Tag WP → (Optional: Enter Catacombs for Trial #5) → Exit to Battlefront
steps.layout_tell: Walk NE through two narrow broken statue bottlenecks; The Catacombs (Trial #5) is right near the Waypoint, and Battlefront is further NE.
steps.portal_tip: Tag Marketplace WP so you can run The Catacombs (Lab Trial #5) anytime!

actions.text: Head North-East through the narrow broken arches to the Waypoint
(Now or Later) Enter The Catacombs near WP for Lab Trial #5
Continue North-East from WP into The Battlefront

steps.boss_info: Marceus the Defaced (near exit): Uses Cyclone & Summon Statues.
steps.gem_reward: Normal Lab Trial 5 of 6 is inside The Catacombs.

variants.title: NE Diagonal Street
variants.desc: WP and Catacombs sit mid-zone; Battlefront is at the top-right.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural: Catacombs (Trial #5) spawns mid-zone; Battlefront exit is NE

steps.summary: Head to Center Waypoint → Go SW for Ribbon Spool → Go NW to The Docks OR North to Solaris Temple
steps.layout_tell: From the central Waypoint: South-West = Blackguard Chest (Ribbon Spool), North-West = The Docks, North-East = Solaris Temple.
steps.next_exit: Loot Ribbon Spool (SW) → Enter The Docks (NW) for Sulphite → Then Solaris Temple (NE)
steps.portal_tip: Tag The Battlefront Waypoint at the center so you can jump straight to Solaris after The Docks!

actions.text: Run to the center-left ridge & tag The Battlefront Waypoint
Drop South-West from WP → Loot Ribbon Spool from Blackguard Chest
Head North-West into The Docks (grab Sulphite, then WP back for Solaris)

steps.boss_info: Captain Aurelianus (guards Ribbon Spool): Fire/Physical shield charge.
steps.gem_reward: Ribbon Spool + Thaumetic Sulphite unlock Infernal Talc at Lady Dialla.

variants.title: 3-Way Hub from WP
variants.desc: SW = Spool, NW = Docks, NE = Solaris Stairs.

steps.summary: Check long wooden piers on the West/South-West edge → Loot Thaumetic Sulphite → Logout or WP to Battlefront
steps.layout_tell: The Supply Container (Thaumetic Sulphite) always spawns at the end of one of the long wooden piers extending over the water.
steps.next_exit: Loot Thaumetic Sulphite → Teleport to Battlefront WP → Enter Solaris Temple Level 1
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after clicking Supply Container → Take WP to Battlefront → Climb NE stairs to Solaris!

actions.text: Search the wooden piers for the Supply Container → Loot Sulphite
Relog to Town → Take WP to Battlefront → Enter Solaris Temple (NE)

steps.boss_info: Voidbearers (Fire-breathing dogs): High Fire shotgun damage if multiple breathe on you at once!
steps.gem_reward: Combines with Ribbon Spool at Lady Dialla in Solaris Level 2.

variants.title: Parallel Piers
variants.desc: Check piers along the outer water edge.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural piers: Thaumetic Sulphite spawns at the end of one of the SW/W docks

steps.summary: Follow the golden carpet through Solaris 1 → Tag Solaris 2 WP → Talk to Lady Dialla for Infernal Talc
steps.layout_tell: Follow the red/gold carpet on the floor: it connects the entrance straight to Level 2 and Lady Dialla!
steps.next_exit: Get Infernal Talc from Dialla → Take Solaris 2 WP to The Sewers → Burn Undying Blockage
steps.portal_tip: Do NOT logout after talking to Dialla — use the Waypoint right next to her to go to The Sewers!

actions.text: Follow the carpet through Solaris Level 1 into Level 2
Tag Solaris 2 WP & talk to Lady Dialla for Infernal Talc
Take WP to The Sewers → Burn Undying Blockage → Enter Ebony Barracks

steps.boss_info: Solaris Ribbon curtains: Cast Fireball & Flameblast.
steps.gem_reward: Unlocks Ebony Barracks & Level 28 Main Skill Gems after killing Gravicius!

variants.title: Carpet-Guided Temple
variants.desc: Never leave the main carpet unless a door is blocked.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural temple: Follow the red carpet for the main path through Levels 1 & 2

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint immediately → Head North up the stone stairs → Kill General Gravicius → Enter Lunaris Temple
steps.layout_tell: From the Waypoint right outside the Sewer exit, always head straight NORTH along the water/stairs to find General Gravicius.
steps.next_exit: Kill General Gravicius → Continue North-West into The Lunaris Temple Level 1
steps.portal_tip: Ignore the East path (Imperial Gardens) until you have the Tower Key from Piety!

actions.text: Tag Ebony Barracks Waypoint right outside Sewer exit
Climb stairs North → Kill General Gravicius (unlocks Lvl 28 Gems!)
Continue North-West from Gravicius into Lunaris Temple Level 1

steps.boss_info: General Gravicius: Casts Firestorm & Molten Shell (high Fire damage!). Ruby Ring helps.
steps.gem_reward: Sever the Right Hand (Maramoa): Unlocks ALL Level 28 Active Skill Gems (Cyclone, Ballista, Tornado Shot, Crackling Lance, Boneshatter, Armageddon Brand, Eye of Winter, etc.)!

variants.title: North Staircase
variants.desc: North from WP leads to Gravicius & Lunaris; East leads to Gardens.

steps.summary: Follow carpet in Lvl 1 → Tag WP → In Lvl 2 at cages: Pick side with 1 WAGON (never 2 wagons!) → Kill Piety
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ BEST TELL IN ACT 3: Near the end of Lunaris Level 2, look at the wooden carts beside the stairs: 1 Cart = Correct Path to Piety, 2 Carts = Dead End!
steps.next_exit: Kill Piety → Loot Tower Key → Logout to Town
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after looting Tower Key → Claim +2 Passive Skill Points from Grigor in Town!

actions.text: Follow carpet through Level 1, tag WP, and enter Level 2
Climb 3 sets of stairs in Lvl 2 → At final fork, go to the 1-CART side
Kill Piety & loot Tower Key → Logout → Get +2 Skill Pts from Grigor!

steps.boss_info: Piety: Transforms into Ice Form (high Cold bow shots — hide behind pillars!) and Fire Form (melee chase — run away!). Destroy blue/red portals before she touches them!
steps.gem_reward: Piety's Pets (Grigor in Town): Book of Skill (+2 Passive Skill Points!) + Lvl 31 Support Gems at Clarissa!

variants.title: 1 Cart vs 2 Carts Tell
variants.desc: Always walk past the single wagon/cart to reach Piety's portal.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural temple: Follow carpet in Lvl 1; in Lvl 2 take the side with 1 wagon (not 2)

steps.summary: From Ebony Barracks WP go East → Follow tiled road to Gardens WP → Complete Trial #6 (NW) → Enter Sceptre of God (NE)
steps.layout_tell: Follow the stone tiled road to the Waypoint: from the WP, North-West leads to Lab Trial #6 (Normal Lab 6/6!), and North-East leads to The Sceptre of God.
steps.next_exit: Complete Lab Trial #6 (NW) → Unlock & Enter The Sceptre of God (NE)
steps.portal_tip: Once Trial #6 is done, all 6 Normal Labyrinth Trials are unlocked!

actions.text: Follow tiled road from entrance to the central Waypoint
Take NW path to complete Trial of Ascendancy (Normal Trial 6/6!)
Take NE path from WP → Use Tower Key on Sceptre of God door

steps.boss_info: Porcupine Goliaths: Explode into physical spikes on death — do not kill a whole pack while standing on top of them!
steps.gem_reward: Completing Trial #6 unlocks the Normal Lord's Labyrinth (First Ascendancy)! Skip The Library unless you need niche vendor gems.

variants.title: Tiled Road Fork
variants.desc: At WP: NW = Lab Trial #6, SW = Library, NE = Sceptre of God.

topology.procedural_note: Tiled garden: Follow cobble road to WP; Trial #6 is North, Library NW, Sceptre E/NE

steps.summary: Climb 6 floors of Sceptre & Upper Sceptre (check corners for stairs) → Kill Dominus on Rooftop → Enter Aqueduct
steps.layout_tell: Each floor is a 4-corner grid: stairs up almost always spawn in one of the corners diagonal or adjacent to where you entered.
steps.next_exit: Kill Dominus (2 Phases) → Walk into The Aqueduct (Act 4)
steps.portal_tip: In Dominus Phase 2 (Blood Rain), stand INSIDE his golden proximity shield bubble to avoid bleeding!

actions.text: Climb 3 floors to Sceptre WP, then 3 floors of Upper Sceptre
Kill Dominus Phase 1 (Touch of God slam) & Phase 2 (stay inside bubble!)
Enter The Aqueduct (Act 4)

steps.boss_info: Dominus, High Templar: Phase 1 deals heavy Lightning slam ('The Touch of God!'). Phase 2 stacks Corrupting Blood unless you stand inside his golden shield.

variants.title: 4-Corner Tower Floors
variants.desc: Dash along outer walls from corner to corner to find stairs fast.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural 6-floor tower: Stairs up spawn in one of the 3 non-entry corners on each floor
